author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Manual edit of code is the equivalent of doing ECO by rewiring the gates manually.

The correct way is update the RTL, resynthize, then let the tools figure how to clip the wires at metal layer for you.

You should not manually edit code. You should fix your agentic harness so it generates the correct code for you.
